SELECT 
	SaleType = 'S',
	HeaderNo = SL.HeaderNo,
	AccCode = A.AccCode,
	AccountAliasName = A.AliasName,
	AccountName = A.Name,
	AliasName = I.CustomICode,
	ItemName = CASE WHEN SD.SaleItemDescription IS NULL THEN I.Name ELSE SD.SaleItemDescription END,
	Qty = SUM(SD.LooseQty),
	Bonus = SUM(SD.BonusQty),
	salestax  = ROUND(SUM(SD.LooseQty * (SD.SalePrice - SD.ItemFlatDisc) * (1 - SD.DiscPerc * 0.01) * SD.GSTPerc * 0.01), 2) + SUM(((SD.LooseQty + SD.Bonusqty) * SD.UnitSalesTax)),
	SaleValue = SUM(SD.LooseQty * (SD.SalePrice - SD.ItemFlatDisc) * (1 - SD.DiscPerc * 0.01) * (1 - SL.DiscPerc * 0.01)),
	GstPerc = SD.GSTPerc,
	GSTValue = SUM(SD.LooseQty * (SD.SalePrice - SD.ItemFlatDisc) * (1 - SD.DiscPerc * 0.01) * (1 - SL.DiscPerc * 0.01) * (SD.GSTPerc * 0.01))
FROM
	Accounts A, SaleLedger SL, SaleDetail SD, Item I
WHERE
	:ai_one_or_all = 0 AND
	SL.Date BETWEEN :ad_startdate AND :ad_enddate AND
	SL.Posted = 'Y' AND
	SL.CustCode IN (:ai_custcode) AND
	SL.CustCode = A.AccCode AND
	SL.SaleInvCode = SD.SaleInvCode AND
	SD.GSTPerc > 0 AND
	SD.ICode = I.ICode
GROUP BY
	SL.HeaderNo,
	A.AccCode,
	A.AliasName,
	A.Name,
	I.CustomICode,
	I.Name,
	SD.SaleItemDescription ,
	SD.GstPerc
UNION ALL
